summary: Wild strikes (Garrett, 2026-11-14, with the Jewel Wasp: fauna 'use it against vessels when attacking an ark'): on a hostile, unpacified escort world a wild creature within ArkEscortSO.faunaStrikeReach (24 u plus its body) of a squad vessel plays its attack animation (FaunaAttackDriver) and lands faunaStrikeEffect (the danger contact, petals only, weight 1), at most once per creature every 2.5 s. New ArkEscortRun.Strikes.cs; TickChaos's held-world test moved into LegHeld; five new fields on ArkEscortSO authored into ArkEscort.asset. ECOSYSTEM.md 0.w.
